test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which part of the Constitution of India incorporates the Directive Principles of State Policy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Part IV.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Part IV of the Indian Constitution deals with Directive Principles of our State Policy (DPSP)**

 
 
• **It includes Articles 36-51.**
 
• The provisions contained in this Part cannot be enforced by any court, but these principles are fundamental in the governance of the country and it shall be the duty of the State to apply these principles in making laws.
 
• **The concept of Directive Principles of State Policy was borrowed from the Irish Constitution.**
 
• While most of the Fundamental Rights are negative obligations on the state, DPSPs are positive obligations on the state, though not enforceable in a court of law.
